description: With the same scoped tuple, assignments agreeing on all free variables of a scoped term give it equal values.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.scopedTerm_realize_agree.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] {α : Type u'} {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq α] (t : L.Term (α ⊕ Fin n)) (a a' : α → M)
  (b : Fin n → M) (h : ∀ x ∈ t.varFinsetLeft, a x = a' x) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize (Sum.elim a b) t = FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize (Sum.elim a' b) t
